proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ P X Y r₁ r₂ hI hX hY hmX hmY
  exact (ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun.hasLaw_add_poissonMeasure hI ⟨hmX.aemeasurable, hX⟩ ⟨hmY.aemeasurable, hY⟩).map_eq
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) (X Y : Ω → ℕ) (r₁ r₂ : NNReal), ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun X Y P → P.map X = ProbabilityTheory.poissonMeasure r₁ → P.map Y = ProbabilityTheory.poissonMeasure r₂ → Measurable X → Measurable Y → P.map (fun ω => X ω + Y ω) = ProbabilityTheory.poissonMeasure (r₁ + r₂)
